# Fate UI v0.8.10-beta12

Fork rows are left-aligned, drop the "Fork" label and arrow, and gain a session-actions menu.

## Conversation path (fork) fixes

- **Left-aligned fork titles.** Fork text is left-aligned and lighter than the session title (never bolder, never centered).
- **Removed the "Fork"/"Worktree" label and the arrow.** Forks no longer carry a redundant kind tag or arrow on the right.
- **Per-fork Session actions menu (⋯).** Each fork row has a hover actions menu with **Rename fork** and **Compact fork context**. The menu navigates to the fork first (it becomes the active session), then runs the action. Clone / fork / isolated-worktree are intentionally not offered on forks (no infinite nesting).
- A fork is an in-session branch, so **delete is not offered on forks** — removing a branch would delete the whole session. Use the session row's delete after switching if needed.

## Compatibility and installers

No migration is needed. Existing projects, Pi sessions, settings, themes, and folder history are unchanged.

GitHub Actions builds and tests this release on Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Linux x64. The prerelease contains installers plus `SHA256SUMS`:

- Windows x64: NSIS `.exe`
- macOS arm64 and x64: `.dmg` and `.pkg`
- Linux x64: `.AppImage` and `.deb`

Public beta installers remain unsigned. Windows SmartScreen or macOS Gatekeeper may show an unknown-publisher warning. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS`.
